name: engram-opencode
description: Engram brain-inspired layered long-term memory — opencode plugin. Injects a memory hot-index at session start, runs an independent reviewer on session idle to consolidate what mattered, and adds /engram-* commands. Self-provisions its reviewer/query agents via the config hook. Portable Rust engine + redb store, shared with the Claude Code / Codex adapters.
author: jimhyliu <jimhyliu@gmail.com>
